videos.title: Video URLs or IDs
videos.description: YouTube watch, youtu.be, Shorts or embed URLs, or 11-character video IDs.

playlistOrChannel.title: Playlist or channel URL
playlistOrChannel.description: Get transcripts for the videos in a playlist or a channel's uploads, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/@mkbhd.

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: Search YouTube and get transcripts for the results.

maxVideos.title: Max videos (playlist, channel, search)
maxVideos.description: How many videos to take from the playlist, channel or search results.

language.title: Language
language.description: BCP-47 code of the caption track, e.g. en, es, de. Leave empty for the original or English track.

translateTo.title: Translate to
translateTo.description: Machine-translate transcripts into this language (150+ supported), e.g. en, fr, ja.

format.title: Output format
format.description: JSON gives full text plus timed segments. Other formats are returned in the 'content' field.

includeSegments.title: Include timed segments
includeSegments.description: JSON only. Turn off to get just the full text.

timestamps.title: Timestamps in text
timestamps.description: Prefix each line with [HH:MM:SS] in text and Markdown output.

aiFallback.title: AI transcription when there are no captions
aiFallback.description: Transcribe the audio of videos that have no captions. Charged per minute of video on top of the transcript price.
